notes.title: Major Update 1.0.13.888
notes.notes:
Hunters! We have prepared for you another big They Always Run update 🦾

List of changes:

 Added the ability to change the game resolution 
 Added support for windowed display mode
 Fixed an issue with the character getting stuck in the floor of a spaceship
 Fixed an issue with a white flash before the arrival cutscene
 Fixed an issue with picking up the victim's body on diagonal surfaces
 Fixed an issue with incorrect display of the cryopod interaction button
 Fixed an issue with performing a stealth kill on some already defeated enemies
 Fixed an issue with mirrored stealth kill animations in some cases
 Fixed an issue with jumping when clicking "OK" in the reward window
 Other minor fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297547/667ad35652d7e5e34f61993360194039ec616335.png

You can check the current version of the game in the right bottom corner of the main menu.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1585440
If you have any questions or issues with the game - you are welcome on our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/Ws4EMCS2P9 💙

notes.title: Update 1.0.6.810
notes.notes:
Hey hunters! To make your hunt more efficient, we have prepared a Friday update 🎃

List of changes:
 Added save slots
 Improved the controls responsiveness
 Improved some aspects of the platforming
 Improved response to shotgun blasts
 Rearranged lighting in certain areas
 Fixed moving plants on Angel's Heart — restart the level if you’ve faced this issue
 Fixed the camera bug when entering the ship at Angel's Heart
 Fixed flying through doors after counterattack
 Fixed swordsmen hitting out of the block that used to happen before the animation
 Fixed not being able to jump off the platform when taking damage
 Fixed enemies flying away from a strong third hand strike in a combo
 Fixed sniper's weapon hanging in the air after his death
 Fixed pieces of destroyed items hanging in the air

notes.title: Update 1.0.4.796
notes.notes:
Knock, knock! We've already prepared a new update to They Always Run for you 📝
 
List of changes:

 Added control button icons for DualShock controllers (PS4)
 Added missing underlays under the additional energy cells
 Improved the controls responsiveness (and still working on it)
 Emphasized knocking down the block of the guys with shields

 You can now open the settings in the pause menu
 You can't jump over the ship on Charade anymore
 Fixed the timings of some dialogs
 Fixed Chinese characters where they were displayed incorrectly
 Fixed a rare bug with the third hand in level 2
 Other minor fixes
